Name: Pokemon Battle Companions
Author: netherphnx
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Kill monsters to collect Pokeballs! Open them to capture pokemon!
Pokemon will follow you around and attack monsters, gaining EXP and leveling up![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Make sure SMAPI is installed[/color]
Download and drop the mod into the mods folder

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]THIS IS ONLY THE MOD ENGINE, you will need a region pack to make this playable.[/color]

Grab them here -> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47815]Kanto[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47816]Johto[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47817]Hoenn[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47818]Sinnoh[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48005]Unova[/url]

I'll be adding more regions as I have time.

[color=#D4D4D8]Collect pokemon through a basic gacha system. Killing monsters can spawn Pokeballs, Great Balls, Ultra Balls, or Master Balls.
Pokemon have a rarity based on catch rates, splitting them into the common, uncommon, rare or legendary pools.

Gacha Tables:[/color]
[spoiler][b]Ball Drop Rates (updated):[/b]

[code]Ball         | Per kill | Roughly
-------------|----------|------------------
Poké Ball    | 6.47%    | 1 per 15 kills
Great Ball   | 1.55%    | 1 per 65 kills
Ultra Ball   | 1.55%    | 1 per 65 kills
Master Ball  | 0.43%    | 1 per 232 kills[/code][b]Pools:[/b]

[code]Ball         | Common | Uncommon | Rare | Legendary
-------------|--------|----------|------|----------
Poké Ball    | 75%    | 22%      | 3%   | 0%
Great Ball   | 40%    | 45%      | 14%  | 1%
Ultra Ball   | 10%    | 35%      | 50%  | 5%
Master Ball  | 0%     | 0%       | 0%   | 100%[/code][/spoiler]
Monsters now have types which influence their damage to pokemon and what items they drop.

Open the party and pokedex menu with the 'P' Key. Configurable.

The Pokemon PC will arrive by mail the day after you open your first pokeball.

Items required for evolution are added to monster drop tables, fishing treasure, grass cuts, lightning rod procs, and geode rewards. They only spawn if you have a region pack installed that needs them — you won't see any Ice Stones if you only have the Kanto pack installed. Some shop items won't show up until you've captured the pokemon that needs the item.

The adventurer's guild now sells potions and revives.

Pokemon gain and lose friendship based on your actions and events with them.

Pokemon with multiple forms are supported! Castform will change with the weather, you can collect all the Unown, Choose Arceus and Deoxys's forms manually, etc.

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24104]Pokemon Berry Bushes[/url] installed, then you can feed pokemon berries to boost their friendship. Results are determined by pokemon natures. You can also use berries that normally restore HP to heal your pokemon.

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed you can tune some of the features, including spawning a trainer that will hang out in the saloon and sell pokeballs. (Wed/Sat)

Pokedex completion and research! You can donate your duplicates for research shards, which you can then trade for uncaught pokemon from the various pools.
